notes.title: Love Letters: First Bloom 🌸
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the release of our new word puzzle game on Steam! 
Love Letters: First Bloom
offers a fresh take on the genre by blending engaging word challenges with the peaceful ambiance of a spring garden.

Try the free demo version today!

Key Features:

🌸 A unique word puzzle experience in multiple languages

🌸 Mysterious blocks and locked letters that reveal themselves as you solve

🌸 Pattern matching puzzle for extra fun

🌸 Infinite puzzles ensuring endless fun

🌸 Soothing soundtrack to accompany your word-crafting journey

🌸 Full mouse and keyboard support for your preferred playstyle

Whether you're a word game enthusiast or simply seeking a peaceful gaming experience, Love Letters: First Bloom provides the perfect balance of challenge and relaxation. 

Available now on Steam! 

Immerse yourself in this enchanting blend of wordplay and springtime serenity. 

Free demo!
Launch Discount: 20% off!
